translations.english: She was like great fame grown dim, faith slighted, worship meddled and hope frustrated. (Note: Sita's condition is being compared with abstract concepts such as fame, faith, reverence and hope which are hit by reverses in fate. She was the personification of all such suffering.)
translations.hindi: यह तेरी सुन्दर उठती हुई जवानी बीती जा रही है || यह जवानी नदी को घार की तरह है, जो एक बार बह गई, वह फिर लौट कर नहीं ग्रा सकती
